verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's evidence covers document verification, review tools, and API access to results, but nothing indicates AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from the user's own data inside the product. The MCP server (stripe-identity-docs-12) lets AI agents call Stripe APIs but is not an in-product analytics/insights feature. Missing for 10: any dashboard AI summarization, fraud-pattern insights, or suggested actions generated from a merchant's verification data.
